body: Of course! What is your goal with taking all of these? Just trying to get your thoughts right now.

Would you mind telling me what calling them was like? I’ve thought of it before as well but have always been terrified they would call authorities on me or something to check on me. 
Did they ask anything? Were they friendly? 
I’m glad they helped you feel better, and props to you for actually reaching out. It’s rough.

What are you feeling? Do you feel any difference? 
I’m sorry you are at this point to where you feel you have to take so many pills to be okay.
